errors.name: Sum of the series reported as the value of the improper integral
errors.observed_behavior: Asked for the value of the improper integral that matches a series, the response gives the sum of the series instead of evaluating the integral.
non_conceptual_causes: the series summed as a geometric or known series because that was quicker than the integral
the question read as asking for the value the integral test is about
the integral evaluated on scratch work and the series sum copied to the answer line
errors.discriminating_probe: Ask whether the area under the curve from the starting index equals the sum of the rectangles of width one at the same inputs; a student who says they are equal holds the belief, while one who sees the gap misread which quantity was asked for.
errors.scoring_consequence: The value of the integral is not given, so an answer point for the integral's value is not earned.
errors.notes: The reverse direction of BC-ERR-10013, which reports the integral's value as the series sum. Minted 2026-09-26 because the series-sum distractor on the BC-QA-10005 items that ask for the integral's value tests this direction, not that one.
